mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchaseorder ( po_id, supplier_id, employee_id, po_date, audit_status ) VALUES ( #{po_id}, #{supplier_id}, #{employee_id}, #{po_date}, #{audit_status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE purchaseorder SET supplier_id = #{supplier_id}, employee_id = #{employee_id}, po_date = #{po_date}, audit_status = #{audit_status} WHERE po_id = #{po_id}
mapper.select: select * from purchaseorder order by po_id
